sum: Remix Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biotechnology company in the United States. The company develops small molecule therapies designed to modulate RNA processing and address the underlying drivers of disease. It offers products, such as its lead program REM-422, an orally available mRNA degrader targeting the MYB transcription factor, which is implicated in various cancers. It also develops gene therapies for central nervous system diseases. The company is based in Watertown, Massachusetts.
ceo: Dr. Peter G. Smith Ph.D. (Co-Founder, President, CEO & Director)
